title.full: Who can deactivate the CPF Safety Switch

summary.text: Only the member can deactivate it. They must complete the authentication process.

details.heading: Trusted Contacts cannot do this
details.body: No one else, including Trusted Contacts, can request deactivation for the member. Only the member can do it after completing the authentication process.

example_phrasings: Can anyone else, including Trusted Contacts, request to deactivate the CPF Safety Switch on behalf of a member?
Can anyone else deactivate the CPF Safety Switch?
Can a Trusted Contact do this for a member?

sources.page_title: Can anyone else, including Trusted Contacts, request to deactivate the CPF Safety Switch on behalf of a member?

quotes.text: No. Deactivation can only be performed by the member, who must complete our authentication process.
